definitions: A visual image can convey complex ideas and emotions more effectively than a large amount of text.
Visual representations are often more impactful and informative than verbal descriptions.
examples: The architect's detailed rendering of the building truly showed that a picture paints a thousand words.
Instead of trying to explain the intricate design, she just showed them the prototype; a picture paints a thousand words, after all.
The photo essay perfectly captured the essence of the festival, proving that a picture paints a thousand words.
lemma: a picture paints a thousand words
source: a picture paints a thousand words
